scripts.dev:legacy: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=apps/foco" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/caja" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/pulso" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/backend"
scripts.dev:foco+backend: concurrently -n backend,foco -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=apps/backend" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/foco"
scripts.build:legacy: npm run build:shared && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace=apps/shared || echo 'Shared build skipped - no build script'
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace=apps/foco && npm run build --workspace=apps/caja && npm run build --workspace=apps/pulso
